args.body: Turn the queued pilot readback into one durable item 4 decision under the existing assignment. Reuse any committed operator decision or equivalent comparison. Otherwise compare the precise claims in the referenced draft against the direct catalogue readback and its provenance. Save and read back a brief decision listing the supported claims and any claim that depends on the unpublished candidate. If supported, attach the existing draft and evidence to the operator's send-or-decline handoff. If one claim is unsupported but the live offer can satisfy the same pilot, prepare a minimal replacement sentence for the operator and verify it against the live page. Keep external sending with the authorized operator. Record pilot exposure only on a redacted send receipt. Any site revision remains subject to host-enforced independent review.
